title: Uncreated
summary: UNCREA'TED, participle passive 1. Reduced to nothing; deprived of existence. 2. adjective Not yet created; as misery uncreated 3. Not produced by creation. God is an uncreated being.

inlines.v: UNCREA'TED, participle passive 1. Reduced to nothing; deprived of existence. 2. adjective Not yet created; as misery uncreated 3. Not produced by creation. God is an uncreated being.
